notes: MMCS Game Jam 2024 Unity 3D platformer RGBY by Kettle Game Studio (https://kettle-studio.itch.io/rgby; itch lists code license MIT). A parrot changes color to reach its treat. Complete Unity 6000.0.26f1 project (changeset ccb7c73d2c02) with playable scenes Assets/Scenes/Level01.unity–Level05.unity and Assets/Scenes/Finish.unity enabled in EditorBuildSettings. MIT at the repo-root LICENSE (Copyright 2024 Kettle Game Studio). Official Unity packages only in Packages/manifest.json and packages-lock.json (all registry or builtin from packages.unity.com): URP 17.0.3, uGUI 2.0.0, Input System 1.11.2, AI Navigation 2.0.4, Timeline 1.8.7, Visual Scripting 1.9.4, test framework, IDE packages (Rider / Visual Studio), Collab Proxy, Multiplayer Center, and built-in modules. LiberationSans (SIL Open Font License 1.1) is the bundled TextMesh Pro default font; LiberationSans - OFL.txt is retained. TextMesh Pro EmojiOne sprites/asset were omitted; TMP Settings.asset m_defaultSpriteAsset was cleared and m_enableEmojiSupport was set to 0; the playable scenes do not require it. Soundtrack Assets/Sounds/RGBY.mp3, RGBY_pomenshe.mp3, flying.mp3, and steps.mp3 credited on itch.io to team composer Николь Беликова (Nicole Belikova) and included under the repo MIT. Original Blender/Krita sources under Blends/ and parrot/apple/block FBX + albedo textures retained as team art (itch credits Олег Арутюнов / Oleg Arutyunov with 3D art). Assets/Models/122_original.jpeg (md5 2662126aad260e3df7b807f4bcd8d78d, 800x638) omitted: visible Depositphotos watermark, not whitelist OSS; companion .meta omitted, material/GUID refs may remain. Assets/Models/korma-dlja-ptic-kartinka.jpg (md5 8d09efedca2867f8f56aeb2bdfe9c925, 2560x2036 bird-feed photo) omitted with .meta: professional stock-like photo with an ASCII EXIF UserComment fingerprint, source unverified (verified_only); material/GUID refs may remain. bars.png retained as original cage-bar art; marble.png retained as a stylized (non-photogrammetry) pattern. Unused URP template SampleScene.unity omitted (not in EditorBuildSettings). No DOTween, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no Asset Store packages, no Library/Logs/DLL, no .DS_Store, no LFS. ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt is retained. ~23M src snapshot after omissions. Claim #4118. Team also: Сергей Дуюнов (code, VFX), Вячеслав Иванченко (level design, code).
